summary_en: Nippon Steel's subsidiary Osaka Steel will conduct a public tender offer to acquire 2,800,000 of its own shares. Nippon Steel, which holds Osaka Steel shares, plans to tender all its holdings in response to the subsidiary's request. Following the sale, Nippon Steel's voting ratio in Osaka Steel is expected to fall to 51.0% (51.5% on a consolidated basis).
summary_jp: 日本製鉄の子会社・大阪製鐵が普通株式280万株を対象とした自己株式公開買付けを実施する。日本製鉄が保有する大阪製鐵株式は全量応募予定。売却後の日本製鉄の議決権比率は51.0%（連結51.5%）となる見込み。
